title: This $30 AI storage cleanup app saves you from buying more cloud space
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Cleaner Kit for iOS is an AI-powered cleanup app for photos, videos, contacts, and email, and a lifetime Premium Plan subscription is on sale for $29.99 (reg. $104.97).

An iPhone fills up fast with duplicate photos, blurry screenshots, and old emails nobody needs anymore. Cleaner Kit for iOS clears all of that with AI-powered scanning, and a lifetime Premium Plan subscription is on sale for $29.99 (reg. $104.97).

Camera roll scans catch duplicate and low-quality photos and videos, and a swipe right keeps a shot while a swipe left archives it for later deletion. Video compression shrinks file sizes without a visible drop in quality.

Contacts get merged and cleaned of empty or unnamed entries, and Gmail’s inbox sorts by sender, so old messages clear out in bulk rather than one at a time. A secure vault stores private files and contacts behind additional access controls, and everything is processed on the device itself rather than in the cloud.

More than 70 million people already use the app, and it has 4.5 stars on the App Store based on over 280,000 ratings. Redeem the code within 30 days of purchase.

Cleaner Kit works on iOS 15.0 or later, and the deal is limited to one device for new users only.

Stop juggling a full camera roll and a cluttered inbox. Get a Cleaner Kit for iOS Premium Plan lifetime subscription on sale for $29.99.
